name: South Asian Enterprises Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1990, South Asian 
Enterprises Ltd runs amusement 
parks and other activities, including
trading in earthing and lightning 
protection systems[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SAEL deals in earthing materials and lightning protection systems including installation in the electrical engineering segment. It executes contracts in the electrical engineering under the trading segment. 
The power utilities, electronics, and other hi-tech centres, where earthing is important, are its target customers apart from highrise buildings, hotels, residential units, etc.

cons: Stock is trading at 5.09 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -28.7% over last 3 years.
